Join me on a scenic drive from Rajgir to Gaya, showcasing the stunning roadside sceneries of Bihar. This video takes you on a virtual tour of the picturesque landscapes, rolling hills, and quaint villages that dot the route.
From the majestic mountains of the Rajgir hills to the serene beauty of the Gaya countryside, this drive is a treat for the eyes. We'll pass through bustling towns, rural villages, and scenic viewpoints, giving you a glimpse into the daily life and culture of Bihar.
